May 19, 2018 - By Richard Conner
Jonathan Kolatch decreased its stake in General Mtrs Co (GM) by 25.7% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Redwood Capital Management Llc sold 138,392 shares as the company’s stock declined 17.02% with the market. The hedge fund run by Jonathan Kolatch held 400,000 shares of the auto manufacturing company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $16.40 million, down from 538,392 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Redwood Capital Management Llc who had been investing in General Mtrs Co for a number of months, seems to be less bullish one the $53.26B market cap company. The stock decreased 1.33% or $0.51 $37.79. About 5.58 million shares traded. General Motors Company (NYSE:GM) has risen 0.46% uptrending. It has underperformed by 11.09% the S&P500.
Brad Farber decreased its stake in Facebook Inc (FB) by 10% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Atika Capital Management Llc sold 5,000 shares as the company’s stock declined 14.10% with the market. The hedge fund run by Brad Farber held 45,000 shares of the technology company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $7.94 million, down from 50,000 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Atika Capital Management Llc who had been investing in Facebook Inc for a number of months, seems to be less bullish one the $528.79B market cap company. The stock decreased 0.59% or $1.08 $182.68. About 10.38M shares traded. Facebook, Inc. (NASDAQ:FB) has risen 8.48% uptrending. It has underperformed by 3.07% the S&P500.
Atika Capital Management Llc, which manages about $258.67M US Long portfolio, upped its stake in Portola Pharmaceuticals Inc (NASDAQ:PTLA) by 12,000 shares to 70,000 shares, valued at $3.41M in 2017Q4, according to the filing. It also increased its holding in Floor & Decor Hldgs Inc by 13,000 shares in the quarter, for a total of 93,000 shares, and has risen its stake in Arista Networks Inc (NYSE:ANET).
